;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan]]
**32 people were killed by the [[Taliban]] while the Taliban lost 25 of their members in shooting attacks across [[Afghanistan]] [https://www.rferl.org/a/afghanistan-police-killed-in-taliban-attacks/29700982.html (RadioLiberty)]
*[[Yemeni Civil War (2015–present)]]
**A [[Houthi movement|Houthi]] [[drone strike]] on [[Al Anad Air Base]] in [[Lahij Governorate]], [[Yemen]], during a military parade, kills six soldiers and injures several senior officials. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-46822429 (BBC News)]
*[[South Thailand insurgency]]
**Four civil defense volunteers were shot dead by suspected militants in a school in Pattani's Yarang District. Police suspect the attack could have been done by Barisan Revolusi Nasional. Two insurgents were later killed by the police. [https://thethaiger.com/news/south/update-four-defence-volunteers-killed-at-school-by-militants (''The Thaiger'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[2018 Democratic Republic of the Congo general election]]
**After several delays, the Congolese [[Independent National Electoral Commission (Democratic Republic of the Congo)|election commission]] announces that [[Félix Tshisekedi]] is the winner of the December 30 presidential election. [https://www.france24.com/en/20190110-opposition-candidate-felix-tshisekedi-wins-dr-congo-presidential-poll-says-electoral-commis (France24)]
**Popular candidate [[Martin Fayulu]], who came in second, claims the election was rigged and says he will challenge the result. [https://www.apnews.com/64b3de3ee8e1482682d16654b20f517e (AP)] 
*[[Crisis in Venezuela]], [[Second inauguration of Nicolás Maduro]]
**[[Nicolás Maduro]] is sworn in for his second term as [[President of Venezuela]] amid widespread condemnation over his [[2018 Venezuelan presidential election|election]] as "illegitimate". [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-politics/venezuelas-maduro-starts-new-term-as-u-s-decries-him-as-usurper-idUSKCN1P40DH?il=0 (Reuters)]
**Germany has announced its support for the [[National Assembly (Venezuela)|Venezuelan National Assembly]] to take over Executive powers in Venezuela. [http://www.el-nacional.com/noticias/mundo/alemania-apoya-para-que-asuma-poder_265634 (''El Nacional'')]
**Several Latin American countries close their embassies in Venezuela in protest of Maduro's "illegitimate" election. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/01/peru-paraguay-recall-diplomats-maduro-inauguration-190110180310100.html (Al Jazeera)]
**[[President of the National Assembly of Venezuela]], [[Juan Guaidó]], declares a State of Emergency as the country enters a "''[[de facto]]'' [[dictatorship]]". [http://www.asambleanacional.gob.ve/noticias/_an-se-declara-en-emergencia-ante-la-usurpacion-de-nicolas-maduro-en-el-cargo-de-la-presidencia-de-la (Asamblea Nacional)]

;Science and technology

[https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/jan/10/fireball-over-new-zealand-was-satellite-russia-confirms (''The Guardian'')]
